boundedClaim: Source-only accessibility interaction semantics for the existing latest-message TextView may advance without touching P0/phone surfaces or creating a neighboring UI owner.
requiredConstraints: Preserve latest changing TextView text as the semantic value; do not restore a masking non-null contentDescription.
Keep OperatorOverlayService as the sole native owner.
Use the standard ACTION_CLICK accessibility action with an explicit expand/collapse label rather than inventing a parallel control.
State/confirmation semantics must respect minSdk 26 and may use stateDescription only behind API 30 gating.
Any explicit confirmation announcement must honor the existing mute contract.
Regression source is not TESTED evidence; runtime TalkBack and phone delivery remain NO.
Phone/P0 consumption and mutation stay zero.
